source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check information in release note
1. General information
2. FW Version
3. New features/defect fixed
4. Known issue

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. All information should be readable and no spelling error
2. FW Version should be correct
3. Description of new features, defect fixed and known issues should be clear"

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Human review of readability, version and descriptions.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO; correctly retains human documentation judgment but understates agent evidence support.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds extraction, hashing, version and traceability checks with human wording approval.

original_test_intent: Confirm the exact BIOS package release note is readable, spelling-clean, version-correct and clearly/accurately describes general information, new features, fixed defects and known issues.
original_method: Preserve and render the exact document, compare its version and entries with authoritative package/change records, produce page/section findings, and have an engineering/documentation owner perform the required readability, clarity and technical-accuracy judgment.
manual_activity: A human documentation/engineering owner must judge readability, spelling acceptability, clarity and technical truth in context. The agent may extract, render, compare and flag candidates but cannot claim the source's subjective core acceptance is complete.
required_inputs: Original release-note artifact and file hash
Matching firmware package/build manifest and target matrix
safety_requirements: Do not modify, silently correct or republish the source document.
Bind every finding to the exact artifact hash and page/section.
Do not treat grammar-tool output as approval of readability or technical accuracy.
Do not invent missing release content or infer version correctness without an authority.
Keep automated findings separate from the engineer verdict.
agent_execution_scope: Hash, extract and render the release note without altering it.
Check required sections and compare versions/features/fixes/issues with supplied authorities.
Produce traceable findings and a review packet for the human owner.
engineer_actions: Read the rendered source and judge readability, spelling and clarity.
Validate technical accuracy and completeness against package/change ownership.
Issue PASS/FAIL and request source correction where needed.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its manual-only conclusion matches the subjective core but it incorrectly implies the agent cannot perform useful structural/version/traceability checks.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No execution command is intrinsic; use format-appropriate read-only parsing/rendering and checksum tools only as evidence aids.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All four content areas, three criteria and 10/10-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: HYBRID EVIDENCE SUPPORT; HUMAN CORE ACCEPTANCE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Generate an artifact-hash-bound section/traceability matrix and rendered pages, then route subjective and technical language decisions to the authorized owner.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Any BIOS firmware package with a release-note artifact and authoritative manifest/change records.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record document format/parser/renderer version and artifact hashes.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: The project firmware manifest, change-control records and documentation standard supplied by the owner.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds reproducible extraction and traceability evidence but does not automate the human acceptance criterion.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Automated spelling and language models can miss domain meaning or flag valid product terminology.

project_override_considerations: A project may define language, style and required traceability fields. Those criteria must be documented; they do not remove the human semantic review required by this source.
expected_evidence: Release-note/package hashes, document revision and rendered pages
Feature/fix/known-issue traceability matrix with page/section references
Automated spelling/readability candidates clearly labeled non-verdict
Human reviewer comments and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criteria consistently request release-note content and human-readable clarity; the stray closing quote is a minor typographical defect, not an intent conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The review intent is clear. Missing artifacts or authorities are readiness inputs; the final core remains an explicit human task.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps MANUAL ONLY for the core but restores agent-assisted evidence and version checks.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains all extraction/traceability improvements while correcting its hybrid classification because subjective document judgment is the acceptance itself.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates agent Tool Result/evidence from the human engineer verdict rather than calling the whole case BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Makes the manual decision reproducible and artifact-specific without pretending grammar checks can approve technical documentation.
independent_technical_reasoning: The dominant criteria are readability, spelling and clarity/accuracy of technical descriptions, which require human semantic judgment. That is core acceptance, not merely setup, so MANUAL ONLY is appropriate even though substantial evidence preparation is automatable.

source_provenance.history: review_round_02_functionality.md exact-code entry and repository exact-code search

no_automatic_retry: Do not repeatedly re-parse with different settings to hide extraction defects or auto-edit/resubmit the document after a finding.
